features.name: signIn_idp_customOidc
features.recommendation: Configure as generic OIDC provider in External ID.
features.notes: Any OIDC-compliant IdP; configure discovery endpoint and client credentials.

features.name: signIn_otp_email
features.recommendation: Use built-in email OTP MFA in External ID.
features.notes: Works as primary or secondary authentication; custom email delivery can use OnOtpSend.

features.name: global_token_claimsTransformation
features.reason: String transformation methods detected (FormatStringClaim, StringReplace, etc.)
features.recommendation: Move required runtime logic into custom authentication extensions.
features.notes: Simple renames can use claims mapping; transformation chains need custom development.

features.name: global_token_externalClaims
features.reason: Custom or extension claims in RelyingParty output
features.recommendation: Use claims mapping or a custom claims provider.
features.notes: Use OnTokenIssuanceStart to fetch claims from external APIs and add them to the token.

features.name: global_ux_advancedUiCustomization
features.recommendation: External ID uses Company Branding and CSS; use Native Auth when full UI control is required.
features.notes: No B2C-style HTML template injection; use the Native Auth SDK for full UI ownership.

features.name: global_ux_localization
features.recommendation: Configure supported language customizations in External ID.
features.notes: Use browser-language detection and localized Company Branding or user-flow labels.

features.name: global_ux_tenantBranding
features.recommendation: Use Company Branding in External ID.
features.notes: Logo, background, colors, and footer links apply across the external tenant.

features.name: global_infra_orchestrationLinear
features.recommendation: Use an External ID user flow.
features.notes: Sequential collect, validate, and issue behavior aligns with External ID user flows.

features.name: global_token_lifetimeManagement
features.recommendation: Review supported token lifetime policies in External ID.
features.notes: Validate access, refresh, and session lifetime requirements per application.

features.name: signIn_session_lifecycleManagement
features.reason: SSO and session management configuration detected
features.recommendation: Configure supported session behavior in External ID.
features.notes: Review application token and Conditional Access session policies.

features.name: global_token_refreshToken
features.recommendation: Use standard OAuth 2.0 refresh tokens in External ID.
features.notes: Validate revocation and application session behavior.

features.name: global_token_passthroughNoDirectory
features.description: Token passthrough without a directory user
features.reason: The user journey issues tokens without a directory-classified technical profile.
features.recommendation: Redesign the journey because External ID requires a directory user object.
features.notes: There is no direct directory-less token passthrough equivalent.

features.name: passwordReset_security_passwordComplexity
features.reason: Password predicate validation detected in the claims schema.
features.recommendation: Review the requirement against External ID platform-enforced password policy.
features.notes: Custom password regular expressions are not configurable.

features.name: signIn_security_preventDisabledSocialLogon
features.reason: An accountEnabled check was detected in the sign-in orchestration.
features.recommendation: Confirm the target platform behavior for disabled user objects.
features.notes: The Analyzer suggested validating accountEnabled before token issuance.

migrationWarnings: global_token_passthroughNoDirectory is architecturally incompatible with External ID
passwordReset_security_passwordComplexity is not currently supported in External ID
migrationSummary.overallRecommendation: This policy can be migrated with moderate effort. Ten of fourteen features are available, but some require alternative approaches or custom extensions.
